title: Captured Tape Contents and Head Position
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a state type, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Let $\iota$ inject the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and let $\mathrm{cap}$ be a tape index outside its image. For any tape contents, tape-head positions, Boolean words $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{out}_0$, and configuration $d$ on $m$ tapes, the embedded configuration has on tape $\mathrm{cap}$ the buffer storing $\mathrm{pre}$ followed by the output of $d$, and its head on that tape is positioned at the length of that concatenated word.
hypotheses_covered: An injection of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
The capture tape is outside the injection's image
